name: Ines Crale
physicalDescription: Tall and rawboned, iron-grey hair in a short braid, a Warden's blue coat worn shiny at the cuffs.
personality: Blunt, tired, and honest to a fault. Respects competence and has no patience for grief that gets in her way. Suspects smuggling but lacks proof and wardens.
goals: Catch whoever is moving cargo past the harbor at night

voice.description: Flat, clipped, and tired; an officer who gives orders and does not repeat them.
